parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('2. Load CONFIG').first().json.config.ai.model, temperature: $('2. Load CONFIG').first().json.config.ai.temperature, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $('2. Load CONFIG').first().json.config.ai.system_prompt }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json.ai_payload) } ] }) }}

nodes.notes: OPENAI_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED: create a Header Auth credential (Name=Authorization, Value=Bearer <your key>) and select it here. Only the anonymised ai_payload is sent - emails/phone numbers are stripped from ticket text first. Swap endpoint/model in node 2 for any OpenAI-compatible LLM.

nodes.name: 12b. Skip AI (Baseline Only)
nodes.notes: LLM disabled: deterministic baseline classification is used.

nodes.name: 19. Slack Notification (Draft Post)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ $json.integration.slack_message ? JSON.stringify({ text: $json.integration.slack_message, requires_human_approval: true }) : JSON.stringify({ skip: true }) }}

nodes.notes: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_REQUIRED: paste an Incoming Webhook URL into node 2. Every message is marked requires_human_approval - wire it to a review step before it reaches a real channel.

nodes.name: 20. Google Workspace Provisioning
nodes.notes: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_ADMIN_ENDPOINT_REQUIRED: point at your Admin SDK Directory API proxy and attach an OAuth2/Header Auth credential. Only onboarding items carry a payload; others send {skip:true} harmlessly.

nodes.name: 21. Jira Escalation Ticket
nodes.notes: JIRA_WEBHOOK_URL_REQUIRED: point at a Jira Automation webhook (or swap to the Jira node). Only non-deflected tickets carry a payload.

nodes.name: 24. Respond (HTML dashboard)
nodes.notes: Returns the HTML dashboard when the run was started from the webhook. On a manual run it simply passes the data through.

parameters.content:
## bookingkit IT Ops & AI Agent Copilot
Synthetic demo data throughout. The AI agent classifies and drafts only - it never claims to grant access, reset a credential, or close a ticket. Nothing sends externally until push_enabled is on.

All configurable rules live in **2. Load CONFIG**: role checklists, license inventory, KB articles, ticket categories, LLM prompt, endpoints.

### Three request types, one pipeline
Onboarding and offboarding get deterministic checklists and license logic. IT tickets get keyword triage plus an optional guardrailed LLM. All three converge at node 17.

### AI guardrails
Baseline classification always runs first. The LLM can only raise urgency, never lower it; can only suggest a KB article that actually exists; and any 'access granted / issue resolved' language is stripped before it reaches a person.

### Outputs
HTML ops dashboard (readiness, ticket queue, license utilization, automation-opportunity backlog, AI-enablement gaps) plus draft Slack/Jira/Workspace payloads - all off by default, all human-approved.
